Insights

Questions worth asking early.

Practical legal information on disputes, employment, property, family law, contracts and brand protection.

Family law

Before filing for divorce in Kenya

Start by identifying the type of marriage, the relevant documents, any children involved and the property questions that may need attention.

Employment

Preserve the employment record

Contracts, correspondence, payslips, warnings and disciplinary documents may become important if a workplace dispute develops.

Conveyancing

Due diligence before commitment

Property transactions should be checked before money and signed documents move between parties.

Litigation

Preserve the record before the dispute escalates

Messages, agreements, receipts and other records can materially affect how a dispute is understood and presented.

Corporate

Contracts should answer the difficult questions early

Payment, performance, risk, termination and dispute clauses matter most when the relationship stops going smoothly.

Intellectual property

A business name is not the same as a trademark

Business registration and trademark protection address different legal questions and should be considered separately.
